title: Delivery Glossary & Definition of Done (customer projects)

definitions.meaning: Verified end-to-end in staging against the customer's systems and signed off by QA. Safe to communicate externally.
Confirmed and accepted by the customer where acceptance applies.
All milestones due to date are Confirmed per this glossary and no High risks are open.

context_note: Applies to all customer-facing reporting. Engineering and PMO teams maintain their own working vocabularies for internal use.
content:
Purpose. This glossary defines status terms used in reporting to customers and external stakeholders. Internal team vocabularies may differ; when internal reports are reused for external communication, statuses must be re-checked against these definitions.

Confirmed: the deliverable has been verified end-to-end in staging against the customer's systems and signed off by QA. Code being merged or unit-tested is not sufficient.

Green (external): every milestone due to date is Confirmed in the sense above and no High risks are open. If any integration has not been verified end-to-end, report Amber with a stated condition.

Risk rating: a risk that could stop go-live and has no named owner must be rated at least Medium.
